text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deemed to have both the ability and 
physical conditioning, Mejiro Ardan heads 
into the Satsuki Sho. Even in her first 
Classic GⅠ, she remains calm and composed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Ardan harboring a quiet 
fighting spirit, Yaeno Muteki and the 
others burn with competitive fire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Triple Crown. The fierce battle was just 
about to begin...!
